messages:
maya: Heads up — planning rollforward for venturi-v2 into the catalog during the 2024-07-18 change window (01:00-03:00 UTC). Targeting 10% canary in NA/EU. Pin strategy: prevent auto-upgrade of the quant path, and deconflict fallback ordering. @jack @sanjay FYI.
jack: Ack. I’ll prep capacity reservations and watch the node drain. Can we set a latency guard (p95) and an error-rate rollback threshold?
sanjay: yes please. Also paste the exact fallback ordering so I can update runbooks.
maya: fallback ordering (current plan):
```
fallback_order:
 - venturi-v1-quant
 - venturi-v1
 - orbit-lite
 - small-llm-fallback
```
Pin for rollforward: venturi-v2@rev-20240710 (explicit catalog pin, no floating tags).
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] thread_ts=1719987654 deploy_id=dpl-20240718-01 change_window=2024-07-18T01:00:00Z/2024-07-18T03:00:00Z canary=10% auto_rollback_conditions={"p95_latency_ms">2000, "error_rate_pct">2, "sustained_minutes">3}
olivia: I’ll add a short release note and link the docs PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/324 — include the rollback criteria and which metrics page to watch.
remy: quick Q — are we also pinning the GPU quantized kernel variant? if platform auto-selects a newer kernel it could change perf.
maya: good catch — pin kernel_variant=nv-kernel-v3 for venturi-v2 in catalog metadata. I’ll push the catalog PR now.
jack: ops checklist: reserve dedicated capacity at 00:30 UTC for NA/EU, enable debug traces for the first 15 minutes of canary, and attach a temporary alert to the rollout tag. I’ll post the monitor links in this thread before window.
sanjay: add a rollback call participant list: @maya @jack @olivia @sanjay — if auto-rollback trips we do an immediate rollback and start postmortem timer. +1 to holding a 30-min golden window after rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy started deploy_id=dpl-20240718-01 canary=10%
jack: monitor links: https://telemetry.internal/r/venturi-v2-canary-dashboard (watch p95, 99, and error-rate). I enabled temporary alert rules.
olivia: released note draft: "Venturi v2 (rev 20240710) staged canary during maintenance window. Fallbacks pinned to venturi-v1-quant first. Auto-rollback triggers on high p95 or error rate. See PR 324 for docs." :thumbsup:
maya: thanks team — will update the catalog PR with kernel and pin details and ping when the canary hits 10%.
deploy-bot: deploy completed deploy_id=dpl-20240718-01 status=canary_10%
